name: Jade Phial
summary: In Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage entrusts the Jade Phial to young initiates. It carries sacred water from Teldrassil’s moonwells to replenish the druids’ central well in Darnassus.

sections.title: A Vessel for Sacred Waters
sections.body: The Jade Phial gathers water from a moonwell near Starbreeze Village. Teldrassil’s many moonwells channel lunar and natural energies that matter to night elf society and druidic worship. From time to time, the druids replenish their central moonwell in Darnassus with water from wells across the great bough. Corithras Moonrage entrusts the phial to young initiates, who use it to collect pure water without disturbing the moonwell’s spiritual potency.

faq.q: What is the Jade Phial used for?
aliases: why do i need jade phial
faq.answer: The Jade Phial collects sacred water from the moonwell just outside Starbreeze Village. Once it is filled, return it to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar so the druids can replenish their moonwell in Darnassus.
Corithras Moonrage, a night elf druid in Dolanaar, provides the Jade Phial to adventurers undertaking the rite known as the Crown of the Earth.

faq.q: Where does the water from this phial end up?
faq.answer: The water gathered in the phial is carried to Darnassus to replenish the central moonwell maintained by the Cenarion druids.

angles.text: As a young druid, carrying the Jade Phial is an early lesson in caring for Teldrassil’s moonwells, whose vitality calls for constant reverence and care.
As a night elf, you know moonwells mark the enduring bond between the kaldorei and Elune. Tending them with vessels like the Jade Phial is a sacred duty.
